note: Observed cloud dataset projected to factual fields. Captions, descriptions, social titles and image URLs are omitted; content_hash belongs to the original full row. Source observations are historical, not current promises.
limits: Full https://www.tiktok.com/@username/video/ID URLs only. No short links, numeric IDs alone, photo posts, profile feeds, keyword/hashtag discovery, comments, private videos or downloads. Views and engagement are public source counters at collection time, not independently audited measurements. Caption languages indicate advertised subtitle tracks; the Actor does not fetch caption files, transcribe speech or deliver transcript text. Music metadata is descriptive and confers no licence to use the audio.
